rules.reason: Exclude conventional cache, build, coverage, distribution, generated-source, and installed-dependency trees from retrospective path review; the exact matched paths are recorded in the manifest.
Exclude a changed file from text review when either extant blob side of its parent comparison contains a NUL byte; the exact path and comparison are recorded in the manifest.
Exclude nested repository contents because the outer repository stores only a gitlink object ID; the exact path and old/new gitlink IDs are recorded in the manifest.
